name: What is smoke and soot removal, and why is it important?

mainEntity.name: What is smoke and soot removal, and why is it important?

acceptedAnswer.text: Smoke and soot removal is the process of eliminating microscopic, corrosive particles and oily residues that are byproducts of combustion. Soot can embed in porous materials, discolor surfaces, and cause a persistent, unpleasant odor. More importantly, soot is acidic and can cause corrosion and deterioration over time to metal, plastics, and even glass. Professional removal is crucial to prevent long-term damage, neutralize odors, and ensure the indoor air quality is safe for occupants, preserving the property's value and integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smoke and soot removal eliminates corrosive particles and odors, preventing long-term damage, improving air quality, and preserving property value after a fire.
